A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable 30-page versions of the same C2FG paper, including Appendices A-E. Text and rendered-page comparisons support reliable matching of the equations, figures, tables, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original image-generation experiments, quantitative comparisons in Tables 1-7, and empirical analyses and generated examples in Section 4 and Appendix E.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments, including ImageNet and MS-COCO results, guidance-schedule ablations, and qualitative generation comparisons.

M1.justification: The exponential guidance schedule in Equation 14, sampling procedure in Section 3.2 and Appendix D, and integrations with interval guidance and autoguidance are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same 2D toy example, ImageNet evaluations at 64, 256, and 512 resolutions, and text-to-image evaluations. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical within corresponding experiments, including Rectified Diffusion in Table 1, beta-CFG and RAAG in Table 4, and CFG++ and FDG in Table 7.

E3.justification: Sample counts, inference-step budgets, ODE/SDE sampling settings, model configurations, guidance hyperparameters, and evaluation metrics remain identical in Section 4 and Appendix E.

E4.justification: The sampler analysis in Table 3, schedule comparisons in Figures 7-8, lambda ablation in Table 5, and score-discrepancy and denoising visualizations are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged. Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, seed details, confidence intervals, or significance tests for the benchmark comparisons.

E6.justification: All numerical results, plotted trends, and qualitative examples are unchanged. For example, C2FG's ImageNet-256 DiT-XL/2 FID remains 2.07 in Table 1, and its SD1.5 FID remains 16.71 in Table 7.

T1.justification: Theorems, assumptions, definitions, equations, and derivations in Section 3 and Appendices B-C are unchanged. The edits within the proof of Theorem 1 only insert spaces and do not alter mathematical reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same claims about theoretical score-discrepancy bounds, training-free exponential guidance, performance, and compatibility with existing strategies.

C2.justification: The scheduling rationale, qualification concerning singular bounds near t=0, and Appendix E's interpretations of performance trade-offs and baseline behavior are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation disclosures remain identical, including PyTorch/TensorFlow, NVIDIA 4090 GPUs, guidance settings, and Appendix D pseudocode. No code or data access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The references and related-work discussion, including Appendix A's positioning against existing guidance methods, are identical. No cited work or novelty relationship changes.

P1.justification: Appendix B.1 inserts three missing spaces: 'theprobablity' becomes 'the probablity', 'C(x).Note' becomes 'C(x). Note', and 'convince.Assume' becomes 'convince. Assume'. The first-page arXiv stamp updates from v2 dated 9 April 2026 to v3 dated 20 May 2026; document organization is unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1-12 and Tables 1-7 retain identical content, captions, formatting, and placement. The localized prose-spacing corrections and version-stamp update do not change the page or display structure.

improvement.justification: v3 makes three cosmetic spacing corrections in Appendix B.1 and updates the version stamp. The scientific content, empirical evidence, reproducibility information, and substantive presentation remain unchanged, so these edits do not meaningfully affect overall paper quality.
